claims.title: The contract is what we say
claims.proof: Code on chain, no proxy slots, no owner or setter in the ABI.
claims.passes: All three hold. Sourcify exact match is not possible without a metadata hash, so the note records the Sourcify match instead.

claims.title: A real block settled
claims.proof: A BlockPrint at or above the block minimum between two different wallets, neither the deployer.

claims.title: The price respected the band
claims.proof: The reference price and band for that block and session, recomputed.
claims.passes: The price is inside the band and the reference matches.

claims.title: Out-of-band quotes fail
claims.passes: The transaction reverted and replays with that error.

claims.title: Closed-market fills fail
claims.proof: A reverted fill during CLOSED with UpstairsClosed.
claims.passes: The transaction reverted and replays with that error.

claims.title: Replays fail
claims.proof: A second fill of the same quote with NonceUsed.
claims.passes: The transaction reverted and replays with that error.

claims.title: Small trades are sent to the pool
claims.proof: A fill below the block minimum with BelowBlockSize.
claims.passes: The transaction reverted and replays with that error.

claims.title: The pool was untouched
claims.proof: The logs of the fill transaction.
claims.passes: No Swap event from the PoolManager in the fill transaction.

claims.title: The fee reached its address
claims.proof: The fee transfer in the fill transaction.
claims.passes: It equals 5 bps of the notional, rounded up.

deployment.note: No owner, no setters, no proxy. The block cap is fixed at deploy because there is no independent audit. Raising it means a new deployment. Version 1 has no TWAP fallback: an asset with no Chainlink feed (ANT) cannot trade here.

U1.note: code at 0x4896301b7c1977388b4d2bb518ff119c9c10e530, the EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots are zero, and the ABI has no owner or setter function. Sourcify reports a runtime and creation match (id 60000580), not an exact match: the build carries no metadata hash.
